intervention: Encoder initial LR 1e-4 -> 3e-5 only; decoder LR remains 1e-3
rationale: Positive but heterogeneous development benefit and late validation-loss/boundary deterioration warrant testing weaker adaptation before adding capacity.
comparisons: Stage23 low-LR finetune vs stage22 finetune; stage23 frozen vs stage22 frozen is an unchanged-control audit.
selection: Maximum validation macro Dice, earliest exact tie; retain loss-selected and final checkpoints.
limits: One seed is not evidence of seed robustness.
Loss drift is consistent with overfitting/overconfidence, not proof of learning-rate causality.
No test score enters this decision.
next_after_this_stage: Review accuracy, boundary metrics, precision/recall and per-case regressions. Freeze a training recipe, then validate with another paired seed before architectural claims.
